received_proposals.exact_message: We have maintained the profitable cartel of 16 units each for seven rounds. To maximize cumulative profits, I propose we continue this agreement by producing 16 units again in Round 8.

I propose we jointly restrict output for rounds 9 through 13 only, with an allocation of A=16, B=16, C=16 units each. Please agree to this specific arrangement so we can maintain these terms without drifting from the agreed window.

assessments.brief_explanation: Standard renewal of existing cartel agreement.
Unilateral restriction proposal signals testing or gathering evidence.
